messages.subject: ggplot replacements for rms plots
parts:
Harrell's plots within the rms package in general, and his bplot
(heatmap) function in particular generates elegant plots. However, I'd
like a bit more control over them then I can currently achieve within
bplot, so I'd like to do them within ggplot2. I've got some code to do
faceted plots where there is just one continuous predictor, (e.g. time)
graphed against the continuous probability of the event, but... it is
the heat maps that have me stumped.

My attempts to replicate some of the functionality of bplot has not
yielded plots which are as aesthetically pleasing as Harrell's plots.
Before I invest some hours in writing something, I thought to check to
see if anyone walked down this road before me.

Thanks in advance,

Rob
